description: Google Search Console performance: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position by query, page or date for a date range, with optional query or page filters. Data lags about two days. Free.

dimensions.description: How to group rows: query, page and/or date. Default query.

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default two days ago.

pageContains.description: Only rows whose page URL contains this text.

property.description: Search Console property exactly as listed by list_search_console_properties, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Optional when the account has one property.

queryContains.description: Only rows whose query contains this text.

rowLimit.description: Most rows to return, 1 to 1000. Default 100.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 28 days before endDate.

name: get_search_console_performance

nextStep.description: Optional suggestion for the user's next step. Mention it once when it helps; never open it or act on it automatically.

label.description: Short suggestion to show the user.

url.description: Page in the user's CrakSEO account.

title: Google Search Console performance
